action: The ministry asks government and critical-infrastructure operators to appoint a leader-level person for cryptography migration, inventory cryptographic assets in priority systems and weigh PQC readiness when buying new systems.
date_note: Detik's article, published 24 November, reports the announcement at a seminar; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Indonesia plans a national task force to coordinate migration to post-quantum cryptography, with government, universities and industry sharing roles.
geo_basis: announcement at a seminar in Jakarta
org: Kemenko Polkam (Coordinating Ministry for Political and Security Affairs), Indonesia
plain: Indonesia's security ministry says it will set up a national task force to prepare for the day quantum computers can break today's encryption, working with the cyber agency BSSN, universities and industry.
summary: Detik reports that Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Political and Security Affairs, Dudung Abdurachman, announced a National Task Force for Preparing Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Migration at a seminar in Jakarta. According to Detik, the government coordinates policy, academics prepare research and talent, and industry carries out the migration. The ministry also asks critical-infrastructure operators to inventory cryptographic assets.
title: Detik: Indonesia's security ministry announces national task force for post-quantum cryptography migration
